title: Impulse Vault site pack
description: Per-retailer extraction and interception hints. Every field except id/name/domains/selectors is optional; anything missing falls back to the generic strategies (JSON-LD, microdata, OpenGraph, heuristics).

id.description: Unique pack id. Built-in packs use their primary domain. A pack in Options with the same id overrides the built-in one.

domains.description: Registrable domains. 'amazon.in' also matches www.amazon.in and m.amazon.in, never notamazon.in. Empty only for a platform pack, which uses 'detect' instead.

detect.description: Platform pack: CSS selectors that fingerprint the storefront software (e.g. Shopify's meta[name='shopify-checkout-api-token']). Used when no domain pack matches, so one pack covers thousands of brand-owned stores. Any one selector matching is enough.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code used when a price has no symbol, and to disambiguate $, kr and ¥.

productIdPattern.description: JavaScript/RE2-compatible regex run against pathname + search. Capture group 1 is the stable product id (ASIN, itm…, style id). Used for dedupe, canonical URLs and DNR gate rules.

gatePathPattern.description: RE2 regex fragment for the product path with an {id} placeholder, e.g. '(?:dp|gp/product)/{id}'. The DNR gate matches it anywhere in the path, with or without tracking params or locale prefixes. Omit to match the product id anywhere in the path.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical product URL template with {id}. Only set it when a bare-id URL is known to resolve (Amazon's /dp/{id}); it's what 'Yes, buy it' opens and what the price re-check fetches.

keepParams.description: Without canonicalUrl: the only query params kept when canonicalising (e.g. Flipkart's variant 'pid'). An empty list drops all of them. Omit to drop only known tracking params.

selectors.description: CSS selector lists. First element that matches (and has content) wins.

price.description: Text is run through the price parser; MRP/sale pairs and ranges are handled there.

addToCart.description: Buttons intercepted while the item is cooling, and hidden behind the locked countdown.

checkout.description: Proceed-to-checkout / place-order buttons, intercepted on any page of a domain holding a cooling item.

outOfStock.description: Elements whose presence (and text, if outOfStockText is set) means sold out.

vaultAnchor.description: Where the Vault button is inserted (after the element). Defaults to addToCart.

cartPaths.description: RE2 regex fragments for cart/checkout paths, matched at the start of the path (after an optional locale prefix). These drive the hard cart/checkout block.

outOfStockText.description: Lowercase phrases that mean sold out.
